 Jonathan Tepper - Buying Monopolies at Prevatt Capital (EP.375) Mar 18, 2024

 Jonathan Tepper is the CIO of Prevatt Capital, a $450 million
long only firm he founded in 2020 that takes a quality and value
approach to own a concentrated portfolio of global monopolies. He
is also the author of The Myth of Capitalism, a book we discussed
alongside his career path on the show five years ago. That
conversation is replayed in the feed.

Our conversation this time around bookends our prior discussion,
covering Jonathan’s unique upbringing and education on one end and
his creation of Prevatt Capital to apply the lessons from The Myth
of Capitalism on the other.

 

As a disclaimer, I so took to Jonathan when we first met that I’ve
been an advisor to him and Prevatt Capital since launch and am an
investor in the strategy.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
